targeting_gate.verbatim_anchor:
This study aimed to 
assess the rates of recovery of tree biomass under conditions where regener-
ation is occurring naturally. Sometimes, succession can be arrested owing to 
high-intensity land use or seed limitation. We did not target sites where suc-
cession was arrested, so it is possible that our ‘average’ conditions could have 
overestimated rates of recovery when considering all potential areas.
targeting_gate.rationale: Methods explicitly only measure biomass recovery where regeneration already occurs and exclude arrested succession. Benefit-priority map cannot establish practice implementability despite success-language in conclusion.

key_findings: Screen only; biomass map and climaticrecovery regression not establishment suitability.
No climate/elevation thresholds extracted;1,000mmap domain is study scope.
holds: Do not label full extraction complete; supplementary/extended data not inventoried after gate failure.
